value.summary: This change renames the import from `openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` to `openhuman_core as oh`, simplifying the module path. There is no introduction of untrusted input reaching a dangerous sink, no authentication or authorization changes, no new network or subprocess calls, no deserialization of untrusted data, no path traversal, no secrets moving into code or logs, no dependency changes, and no widened permissions in CI configuration. The change is safe to merge.
